messages:
sophie_pm: quick sync — i'm drafting Q3 console/observability goals. two big asks from enterprise accounts: longer trace retention (12mo hot+cold) and a sampling/preview UI for retention that helps debug cost vs quality. can we triage which to prioritize?
ryan_eng: long retention is expensive but customers are explicit. we can do hot 90d + cold archive cheaper. tradeoff is query latency for archived traces.
leo_prod_analytics: +1 on retention tiers. KPIs to decide: 95th pct query latency for trace lookups, and avg cost per archived lookup. we should set target: 95th <= 600ms for archived hits.
maya_research: sampling UI is lower engineering cost and would unblock a bunch of internal support flows (reduce SOC tickets by surfacing why traces were sampled). it's more visible to users too.
dena_support: fincorp outage last month hinged on missing span detail from sampling. they want retention >180d for legal/audit reasons. that is a hard requirement for them.
sophie_pm: proposed compromise: prioritize retention tiering + basic cold-query path (Q3 target), ship minimal retention UI (controls + plan mapping) as MVP. sampling/insights UI moves to Q4.
ryan_eng: technically feasible: implement cold-backend (S3-backed index) + async prefetch for recent queries. estimates: 6w infra + 3w search infra + 2w rollout/QA.
leo_prod_analytics: launch criteria suggestion: (1) retention tiers implemented with plan mapping, (2) cold-query 95th <= 800ms on 5k-sample, (3) billing events emitted + cost dashboard, (4) support runbook and customer opt-in path.
maya_research: must include eval harness: run trace replay against archived store for 10k traces and measure fidelity/latency. also add regression alerts.
sophie_pm: sounds reasonable. @ryan_eng can you drop a rough RFC with the infra plan and risk list by EOD Fri? also include migration considerations for existing customers.
ryan_eng: will do. ETA friday EOD — will include perf targets, rollout flags, and fallback policy to realtime tier.
den a_support: can we add a short customer communication doc? i can draft a FAQ and legal checklist.
sophie_pm: yes please. dena, will pair on FAQ.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: retention-tiering/rfc -> staging at 1850014000, canary at 1850014800, prod rollout window requested 2am-6am UTC.
leo_prod_analytics: one more ask: add cost estimation to pricing page before GA. need numbers for reserved vs on-demand cold retrievals.
ryan_eng: ack — will include retrieval cost model and sample calculations in RFC.
sophie_pm: great — i'll summarize decisions in the roadmap doc and convert to OKRs:
- OKR: Reduce customer incidents caused by missing trace data
  - KR1: ship retention tiers (hot90 / cold12mo) and cold-query path by end of Q3
  - KR2: 95th percentile cold-query latency <= 800ms
  - KR3: support ticket volume related to sampled/retention issues down 30% from baseline

sophie_pm: any blocking concerns?
